articles.description: After missing the past three games with a concussion, Oregon quarterback Dante Moore is not expected to return this season, coach Dan Lanning announced Monday.

images.caption: "If it was up to Dante in any shape, way, he would be out there playing for the guys," coach Dan Lanning said Monday, adding that Moore has not yet been medically cleared. "This isn't a selfish decision on Dante's part ... That's not at all what this is."

Sam Houston ranks 14th on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 30.2%. Both teams are heavily penalized. Missouri State ranks 120th in the FBS averaging 72.0 penalty yards per game, and Sam Houston ranks 126th with a 74.6-yard average. Sam Houston ranks 123rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75.0% of trips. Missouri State ranks 130th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:10, compared to Sam Houston's 53rd-ranked average of 30:36. Team leaders Missouri State Passing: Henry Belin IV, 887 yards, 6 TDs, 4 INTs, 67.6 completion percentage Rushing: Ramone Green Jr., 246 yards on 57 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Myers, 796 yards on 38 catches, 7 TDs Sam Houston Passing: Landyn Locke, 1,653 yards, 12 TDs, 5 INTs, 62.3 completion percentage Rushing: Alton McCaskill, 220 yards on 55 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Tim Burns Jr., 329 yards on 15 catches, 3 TDs Last game Missouri State lost 61-38 to Delaware on Oct. 20. Belin threw for 337 yards on 26-of-35 attempts (74.3%) with two touchdowns and two interceptions. Connor Lair had 85 rushing yards on 15 carries and two touchdowns, adding three receptions for 11 yards. Myers put up 242 yards on 11 catches with two touchdowns. Sam Houston lost 30-24 to New Mexico State on Oct. 21. Locke led Sam Houston with 235 yards on 18-of-31 passing (58.1%) for one touchdown and one interception. M.J. Dowdy carried the ball four times for 17 yards and scored one touchdown. Burns had four receptions for 117 yards and one touchdown. Next game Missouri State plays at Florida International on Nov. 7. Sam Houston plays at Jacksonville State on Nov. 7.
